{"format":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"verdict":{"enum":["A","B"],"type":"string"}},"required":["verdict"],"type":"object"},"messages":[{"content":"Read the passage below and classify how it is written.

A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
Deadline fixed 1 March 2026.
Rules evaluated as of that date.
R1 minimum length 22 pages exactly satisfies requirement.
R2 format requires official template OR three years documented revision history.
R3 Tier-1 venue presentation requires gap more than 18 months before deadline; exactly 18 months fails.
R4 prior Meridian acceptance blocks if under five years elapsed; exactly five years passes.
R5 paired submissions permitted for exactly two manuscripts three or more not permitted.
Both manuscripts must independently satisfy R1 and R2 rules.
At least one pair member must satisfy R3 condition.
R6 Track D exempt from R2 only requires exactly two endorsements one insufficient.
Exemption lifts no other rules.
R7 open retraction notice blocks handling regardless of other rules including R9 exception.
R8 figure count between 8 and 45 inclusive; paired submission max 70 min 8.
R9 fewer than minimum pads up verdict PADDED only if no other rule fails.
Exceeding applicable maximum returns outright regardless of padding logic.
Withdrawal prior round does not count as acceptance under R4 withdrawal.
Withdrawal resets R3 venue clock treated presentation date as withdrawal date.
Verdicts exactly one HANDLED RETURNED or PADDED.
PADDED case failing other rule becomes RETURNED immediately.
Track D exemption applies to R2 only no other rule exceptions apply.
Figure minimum padding applies submission otherwise fully compliant with all rules.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"llama3.3:70b","options":{"seed":3036420478,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false}
